Dynamic banking professional driving Operations, Credit & Regulatory Compliance contributing to Business Growth and Service Excellence

• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to support audits, streamline workflows and optimize operational efficiency within the branch 

• Drove cross-selling initiatives for third-party products, directly contributing to branch revenue and customer portfolio growth significantly 

• Resolved complex customer grievances with empathy and accuracy to enhance client satisfaction and maintaining high service standards

• Effectively mitigated the risks to protect a portfolio during high volatility (elections) period by strategically hedging losses using Nifty futures  

• Earned the Certificate of Appreciation & Performer of the Month awards for exceptional market analysis reports & top-tier analytical skills
